input.summary: Make the Article XIII cap mutual and set it at 12 months' fees, and place indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] The cap currently protects only Licensor and is set at one half of all amounts paid, leaving us fully exposed; we have made it mutual at 12 months' fees, which is our fallback position. We have also placed indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE FEES PAID BY LICENSEE TO LICENSOR UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

ops.text: THE LIMITATION IN SECTION (b) ABOVE SHALL NOT APPLY TO, AND EACH PARTY'S LIABILITY SHALL BE UNCAPPED FOR, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, AND ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
